mapper.select: SELECT CAST(jt.id AS VARCHAR) AS id, jt.name AS name, rk.code AS rankCode, jf.code AS jobFamilyCode, jf.name AS jobFamilyName FROM job_titles jt JOIN ranks rk ON jt.rank_id = rk.id AND rk.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN job_families jf ON jt.job_family_id = jf.id AND jf.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE jt.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY jf.code, rk.code, jt.name

SELECT CAST(jt.id AS VARCHAR) FROM job_titles jt JOIN ranks rk ON jt.rank_id = rk.id AND rk.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_families jf ON jt.job_family_id = jf.id AND jf.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE rk.code = #{rankCode} AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN jf.code = 'DEV' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, jf.code LIMIT 1
